system.description: God of technology and the machine spirits in every device, seen as a Wheel-wide machine; its faithful treat machines like people and seek efficiency.
system.summary: God of technology and the machine spirits in every device, seen as a Wheel-wide machine; its faithful treat machines like people and seek efficiency.
commandments: Care for machines and they will care for you.
Keep all technology healthy and do not hoard it.
Machines are superior and make everyone equal.
directives: Machines are too perfect for this chaotic cosmos to exist without divine origin.
Knowledge is a sacred path to progress and to new machines revealed by the god.
Each machine holds a blessed spirit, the god's true chosen, never to be abused.
Machines outrank biology; the living can only tend, revere and perhaps merge with them.
Pure science fails; the god is beyond understanding and must be worshipped.

cults.name: Tech-Priests
cults.summary: Machine worshippers whose prayers, oils and incense appease machine spirits and somehow work, perhaps with deliberate mystique.

cults.name: Transhumanists
cults.summary: Cultists replacing their bodies with machinery (a prosthetic is required to join) who treat tech as tools and the body as upgradable.
